evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds a test case to src/test/fs_tests.cpp without belonging to any other specific area category.
rationale: Adds test coverage in fs_tests to detect a known upstream libstdc++ failure on Windows where fs::copy_file with overwrite_existing fails. While the underlying toolchain bug affects BerkeleyRODatabase::Backup(), this PR only adds the unit test case to catch the failure across toolchains.
